Project: Peel Region's Downspout Disconnection Program
Activity: {Type} 
Survey status: {expression/expr3} 
Survey period: {Start_Work_Date} - {End_Work_Date} 

The upcoming survey dates show when we plan to do the work. While we'll try to finish the surveys during the listed dates, the schedule might change by 1 or 2 days. Changes can happen because of weather, work needs, or crew availability. 

Last Updated: {EditDate_1}

To start a new search, use the tab at the top of the map named Clear search location or the X next to your address search.

Following this work, if smoke testing is scheduled in your area, you can view the details on our smoke testing page.
